fees.note: From the campground's rates page (read 2026-10-13, after its 2026 season had ended): $58 a night for a 30-amp water and electric site, $61 for 30-amp full hookups and $64 for 50 amps, $366 a week, and $875 or $975 a month (30 or 50 amps) with electric, water, sewer and Wi-Fi included; monthly sites aren't refundable. The campground links its online booking to Campspot, whose listing had no site types on any date read, October 2026 to June 2027.
